captions.detailed: This 3D model features a pair of adjustable, symmetrical wrist cuffs connected by a central crossbar. Each cuff includes a semi-circular main body with integrated mechanical latches on both ends for closure, featuring a female latch receiver on one side and a corresponding male latch hook on the other. The inner circular cutouts can be independently adjusted to accommodate different wrist diameters, and the structure is reinforced with corner braces and cylindrical hinges.
captions.instruction: Design a 3D-printable dual-wrist cuff assembly connected by a central crossbar. The model should feature two adjustable cuffs with customizable left and right wrist hole diameters, using male and female latch mechanisms for closure.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed using a central cube for the crossbar, connected to two symmetrical cuff assemblies positioned at both ends. Each cuff side combines a female latch section constructed from cubes and cylinders with subtracted cutouts, and a male latch section built from boolean unions of cubes. The main curved arm of the cuff uses scaled cylinders and spheres, with a large scaled cylinder subtracted from the center using the 'left_wrist_hole' and 'right_wrist_hole' parameters to define the adjustable wrist openings.
